answer: No, that text isn't legit. Northwind never asks for wire transfers, and if someone texts claiming to be Northwind and asks for a payment, you shouldn't reply. Report it through the Help Center instead. If you really do owe more than our offer (called negative equity), you only pay the difference in person at your appointment. We do that after comparing the offer with your payoff letter, and you can pay by cashier's check or debit card. We don't take personal checks or credit cards. If you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, because an offer never obliges you to sell.
